d:
In this episode of Election Watch, we look at two major political developments ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections in Punjab and Uttar Pradesh.
In Punjab, the BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal have reunited, reviving their old alliance ahead of the polls. What prompted this political comeback, and how could it reshape Punjab's electoral equations?
In Uttar Pradesh, Asaduddin Owaisi has joined hands with Chandrashekhar Azad, raising questions about the Muslim-Dalit vote and its potential impact on the Samajwadi Party. Can Azam Khan counter the Owaisi factor?
